output.answer_markdown: The passages do not give year-end shares outstanding. They report only weighted-average shares for FY2021. On that basis, Kinder Morgan's 2,266 million basic and diluted weighted-average shares [2] were about 1,872.4 million higher than NiSource's 393.6 million basic average common shares [4]. This is roughly 5.8 times as many. If NiSource's diluted average of 417.3 million were used instead, the gap would be about 1,848.7 million.

claims.text: Kinder Morgan's basic and diluted weighted average shares outstanding for 2021 were 2,266 million.
NiSource's basic average common shares outstanding for 2021 were 393.6 million.
